answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the quill queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1972 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the marble. The pulse index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 66 pays that 102 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
